feed.title: NPR Topics: News
feed.subtitle: NPR news, audio, and podcasts. Coverage of breaking stories, national and world news, politics, business, science, technology, and extended coverage of major national and world events.

entry.title: Fears of return to war grow in Ethiopia's Tigray region
entry.summary: Fears are growing of a return to war in Ethiopia's Tigray region, just four years after a devastating conflict ended in a fragile peace deal.

entry.title: Hurricane Polo fuels fears of landslides in Mexico as Nolo closes in on Hawaii
entry.summary: Southwestern Mexico braced for heavy rain and mudslides after Polo became a major hurricane. Forecasters warned another system headed for Hawaii could cause catastrophic flooding later in the week.

entry.title: Judge considers restoring journalists' access to White House after Trump's ban
entry.summary: Lawyers representing the White House and the three media outlets banned from the property sparred over the constitutional rights of journalists at a hearing in federal court Wednesday.

entry.title: Trump and Xi meet at moment of global consequence
entry.summary: It is the second time the leaders are meeting this year after the Beijing summit in May.

entry.title: Iran's president gives a rare wartime speech at the U.N.
entry.summary: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian addressed the U.N. General Assembly a day after President Trump threatened from the same podium to "annihilate" Iran.

entry.title: A Catholic media star will be beatified in St. Louis, moving a step closer to sainthood
entry.summary: Bishop Fulton Sheen, who charmed millions of television viewers on his show Life Is Worth Living,'will come one step closer to being declared a saint.

entry.title: From cybersecurity to AI to Taiwan, what's at stake in Trump's summit with Xi
entry.summary: As President Trump and China's President Xi prepare to meet, Rush Doshi of the Council on Foreign Relations explains the current state of U.S.-China relations and what to expect from this summit.

entry.title: It's getting harder to afford rent in the U.S., even for middle-income families
entry.summary: Housing affordability challenges are spreading to higher income brackets, according to new research, which found one in five renters struggled last year to pay for their housing in full and on time.

entry.title: Greetings from Edinburgh, where a cheeky tour guide makes art history hilarious
entry.summary: For anyone who grew up staring blankly at museum artwork, this is the fun that was missing: Coco leads interactive and (mostly) factual art history comedy tours.

entry.title: Is Nepal's flood a harbinger of what's to come in the Himalayas?
entry.summary: Building dams and hydropower plants in the Himalayas holds great promise for providing electricity. In the wake of the Nepal disaster, experts are asking about the risks of such construction.
